guides.definition: Creates a Serilog logger with a minimum level and console sink. Project dependency only: add Serilog and the desired sinks to a project; the isolated C# runner does not restore packages.

parameters.name: minimumLevel
parameters.description: LoggerConfiguration minimum-level method such as Debug or Information.

examples.title: Configure informational console logs
examples.explanation: The fluent configuration establishes the event threshold and one output sink before application logging begins.

guides.definition: Records a message template whose named property remains queryable by structured sinks. Project dependency only: add Serilog and the desired sinks to a project; the isolated C# runner does not restore packages.

parameters.name: messageTemplate
parameters.description: Quoted Serilog message template with a named property.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Value captured for the template property.

examples.title: Record a completed job
examples.explanation: Message-template properties preserve semantic data instead of flattening everything into one formatted string.

guides.definition: Captures an exception object and a structured operation identifier. Project dependency only: add Serilog and the desired sinks to a project; the isolated C# runner does not restore packages.

parameters.name: messageTemplate
parameters.description: Quoted message template describing the failed operation.

parameters.name: operationId
parameters.description: Context value captured with the exception.

examples.title: Log and rethrow a failed import
examples.explanation: Passing the exception separately retains its type and stack trace; rethrow preserves the original failure semantics.
